rita: FYI team — short heads-up: we're running an AP-simulated failover + SLA wording publish next Wed. Please ack conflicts.

rita: Summary:
- SLA note: legal approved small clarification to maintenance exclusions (no numeric change). Publish to #all-hands before drill.
- Drill window: Wed Jun 30 2026 21:00-22:15 UTC. Scope: sim AZ drain in ap-southeast-1, fail traffic to ap-northeast-1 canaries, light token-heavy replay to exercise cold KV-cache.
- Expected impact: no planned customer downtime; transient canary p99 spikes and 5xx possible. Freeze promotions during window.

sam: Will there be any contract changes customers need to sign?

rita: No contract changes — wording clarification only. Legal memo: https://redwood.internal/legal/sla-exclusions-2026. Please don't forward outside company.

noah: Monitoring plan: temp dashboard with p50/p95/p99, 5xx rate, kv-miss, and routing fallback counts. Pager if 5xx > 12% for 3m. I'll post links 30m before.

lee: I'll update status page templates and draft enterprise notes for affected accounts. Avoid promotions 20:30-23:00 UTC.

ops-bot: Calendar event created: "APAC failover drill + SLA note" Wed Jun 30 21:00-22:15 UTC — invites: #eng-sre, #eng-runtime, #support.

rita: Abort snippets for quick copy:
```
kubectl scale deploy/replay -n stress --replicas=0
infractl routing set-weight --region ap-southeast-1 --pool canary --weight 0
```

sam: Ack — I'll be on rotation that night.

noah: :eyes: will post dashboards ~30m prior.

lee: :white_check_mark: drafting notes now.

rita: Thanks. React with :white_check_mark: when read.

sam: :white_check_mark:

noah: :white_check_mark:
